firstSentence: Automate 3-way invoice, purchase order (PO), and goods receipt note (GRN) reconciliation in enterprise SAP S/4HANA, resolving line-item price and quantity variances in sub-2 seconds.
heroImageAlt: Three-Way Invoice-Purchase Order-Goods Receipt (PO-GRN) Matching Tolerance Telemetry for Enterprise SAP
paragraphs: Enterprise manufacturing and retail organizations running SAP S/4HANA spend tens of thousands of accounts payable labor hours manually reconciling supplier tax invoices against internal Purchase Orders (PO) and Goods Receipt Notes (GRN). Minor variances in line-item unit pricing, freight charges, weight tolerances, or partial deliveries cause SAP three-way matching exceptions, blocking invoice clearing and stalling vendor payments. Unresolved matching exceptions create massive month-end accrual reconciliations and strain vendor relationships.

Our sovereign enterprise accounting engine bridges supplier invoice intake pipelines directly with SAP S/4HANA via secure BAPI and RFC connectors over private direct-connect channels. When an invoice is ingested, the agent extracts line items, quantities, HSN codes, and unit prices, matching them against open SAP purchase orders and warehouse goods receipt documents.

The reconciliation state machine evaluates matching tolerances across multiple parameters: unit price tolerance (±0.5%), delivery quantity tolerance (±1.0%), and statutory tax rate consistency. Invoices within approved corporate tolerance thresholds are auto-posted to SAP (transaction code MIRO) in under 1.8 seconds. Items exceeding tolerance trigger automated discrepancy resolution workflows that route exception tickets to procurement buyers with exact line-item variance highlights.

Compliance strictly conforms to Section 16 of the CGST Act 2017 for input tax credit claiming and Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS). The automated engine processes 50,000+ monthly invoices with an 88% straight-through processing (STP) rate, reducing invoice processing costs by 74% and eliminating payment duplicate errors.

faqs.question: How does the system handle partial shipments where only a portion of the PO was received?
faqs.answer: The state machine matches the invoice against the specific GRN for that shipment, tracking remaining open quantities on the PO and auto-clearing the partial payment.

faqs.question: Does the agent require installing custom ABAP code inside our production SAP S/4HANA instance?
faqs.answer: The integration utilizes standard, certified SAP BAPIs (such as BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE) and standard RFC interfaces, requiring zero modifications to SAP core code.

faqs.question: Can the system handle freight, insurance, and packaging charges added to the supplier invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tolerance engine identifies planned and unplanned delivery costs, matching them against approved SAP purchase order condition types.
